The source is the actual D1 continuation export, SHA `b2cf84538fea52c2e243affcbc2e0896507ccabe63d287d68a307e8986f8972e`. `evidence/sp-014d2a/browser/result.json` records five successful check groups, no browser errors, real public UI inputs and native RAF. This is a historical continuation, not fresh-birth reachability or completion of all milestone D criteria.

The existing balance 425 paid hold80, drive120 and solar60 in economic receipts19–21: balance165, equipment260. The original paid model and its purchase receipt remain unchanged; the modules derive from actually completed trade, survey and ecology missions. Earlier eighteen economic receipts and D1 diplomacy stay exact. Original versus equipped native stationary samples measured about2.82 and4.82 energy/s using actual simulation elapsed time; installation itself grants no energy or health.

The flight export retains twelve produced units of moon-salt, balance165, and a six-second return jump from star2 to home with 0.2seconds elapsed and12 energy already paid. This approximately29-unit jump exceeds the old18 range and fits the paid32 range. The active export is physically docked: its twelve units sold for8 each at the domestic market, yielding96 and final balance261. No foreign treaty bonus is claimed at home. Both paid level-two colonies remain, with sixteen units in each stock. The native run also checked shared-capacity refusal and public import during the paid leg.

Both actual internal generation checkpoints remain the pre-purchase state at tick66066. They contain no ship or paid module and independently activated empty v3 accounts. Public export/import milestones are not new generation checkpoints. `space-outfit-fixtures.test.ts` explicitly prepares separate full midflight/home checkpoints to verify runtime continuation and recovery. These prepared checkpoints and their short unit continuation are not claimed as native evidence. The parser must preserve historical v3 without automatically activating later D2b expansion.

Fixtures are immutable. Unit coverage includes exact hashes, parse/roundtrip, local storage, import rekey, actual old-checkpoint recovery, permanent payment copies, cargo/paid-leg conservation, and malformed receipt/import rejection. Screenshots, performance and cleanup belong to the main native report. Human playtest/listening remain separate acceptance work.
